name: baton
description: An issue spec to a reviewed PR by deliberate handoff, and the way epics are run cheaply: a role table with explicit models, a cost ledger, hooks that stop resumed and unnamed agents, and a retro that improves the plugin through reviewed PRs. Never merges a single issue; an epic merges only through the project gate.

maintainer_handle.title: Maintainer GitHub handle
maintainer_handle.description: Fallback @mention when a delivery blocks. Only used if the issue names no assignee, no author and no 'Escalate to:' line — normally never. Without the @.

escalation_label.title: Escalation label
escalation_label.description: Label applied to an issue when a delivery blocks and needs a human. Must already exist in the repo.

verify_command.title: Pre-commit gate command
verify_command.description: Run with the work staged before pushing review fixes, e.g. 'npm run precommit'. Leave blank if the project has no gate — agents then report the targeted test run alone.

review_passes.title: Review passes
review_passes.description: How many review passes /baton:pr loop runs before stopping. A pass is a review, so 2 means review, apply, review. Raising it buys false positives more than findings.

project_config.title: Project config for epics
project_config.description: A markdown file naming the project's gate, CI wait, worktree tools, verify command, Depends-On pairing, rulings and probe files. Blank: /baton:epic looks for .baton/project.md in the repository.
